categoryName: Kitchenware & cookware — utensils, pressure cooker, tawa, kadhai, containers, tiffin, water bottles, thermos

skuLines.line: Pressure cooker — aluminium outer-lid, 2/3/5 L
skuLines.examples: Hawkins Classic 3L, Prestige Popular 3L, Pigeon Favourite 5L, Butterfly Standard 3L
skuLines.notes: BIS/ISI mark under IS 2347 is mandatory on domestic cookers — never stock uncertified stock. Light but bulky, so hill freight is charged by volume; only stock models whose gaskets you also carry.

skuLines.line: Pressure cooker — stainless steel, induction base, 3–5 L
skuLines.examples: Hawkins Stainless Steel Contura 3L, Prestige Deluxe Alpha 4L, Vinod SS 3.5L, Milton Pro Cook
skuLines.notes: Verified Vinod small-size cookers list ₹1,592–2,712. Induction base is only useful where power is stable — campus quarters mostly run LPG, so keep gas-first SKUs deeper.

skuLines.line: Pressure cooker — hard anodised, 5–8 L (large family)
skuLines.examples: Prestige Nakshatra Plus 6.5L, Hawkins Bigboy 8L, Butterfly HA 5L
skuLines.notes: Hard anodised cannot be scrubbed with steel wool — mis-sold without that advice it comes back as a complaint you cannot easily return over 40 km of hill road.

skuLines.line: Institutional / canteen pressure cooker, 12–22 L
skuLines.examples: Prestige commercial 12L, Butterfly 12L, Hawkins Bigboy 14L
skuLines.notes: Indent line for the two canteens and hostel messes, not a shelf line — order against a written requirement. Very heavy: consolidate with other steel in one consignment.

skuLines.line: Cooker spares — gasket, safety valve, whistle/weight, handle
skuLines.examples: Hawkins gasket B10-09, Prestige sealing ring, universal safety plug, Butterfly weight
skuLines.notes: The single highest-leverage line in a captive market: a perished gasket stops a family cooking, and the alternative is a 30-50 km trip. Stock strictly by the cooker models sold on campus; gaskets are model-specific and have a 2-3 year shelf life (rubber hardens in cold storage).

skuLines.line: Roti tawa — non-stick, 26–28 cm
skuLines.examples: Prestige Omega Select, Hawkins Futura NS, Pigeon Essentials, Nirlon
skuLines.notes: Coating life 12-18 months in daily use, so it repeats faster than customers expect — a real replacement line, not a one-time sale.

skuLines.line: Roti/paratha tawa — iron or cast iron, 25–30 cm
skuLines.examples: Rock Tawa cast iron, Indus Valley, Wonderchef Ferro Light, local lohar tawa
skuLines.marginBand: 20–35% (unbranded iron at the top of the band)
skuLines.notes: Rusts fast in Baru Sahib's monsoon humidity — keep oiled/wrapped in stock and sell with a seasoning instruction slip. Verified Wonderchef Ferro Light cast iron ₹1,249–1,899.

skuLines.line: Dosa tawa — non-stick concave/flat, 30–33 cm
skuLines.examples: Prestige dosa tawa, Butterfly, Vinod
skuLines.notes: Thin-but-real demand: South Indian teaching staff plus canteen breakfast. One facing is enough.

skuLines.line: Kadhai — non-stick with glass lid, 2–3 L / 24 cm
skuLines.examples: Prestige Omega, Nirlep, Hawkins Futura, Pigeon
skuLines.notes: Glass lids are the breakage item in transit — order lid-inclusive SKUs in corrugated inners and carry a damage allowance of 2-3%.

skuLines.line: Kadhai — iron / cast iron, 24–28 cm
skuLines.examples: Indus Valley cast iron, Rock Tawa, local loha kadhai, Dynore iron
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; iron-cooking interest peaks with health campaigns
skuLines.notes: Verified mass-end iron kadhai street prices ₹363–450 on marketplaces, so keep at least one opening SKU under ₹600 or the price gets compared.

skuLines.line: Kadhai/wok — stainless steel or triply, 2.5–3 L
skuLines.examples: Vinod Triply, Milton Pro Cook, Wonderchef Nigella
skuLines.notes: Verified Vinod kadai ₹2,280–3,920 and triply range ₹2,280–8,490. Premium end — one or two SKUs only; this is the fastest-growing mid-premium format nationally but a slow mover at ₹1,493/resident/month.

skuLines.line: Fry pan / omelette pan — non-stick, 20–24 cm
skuLines.examples: Prestige Omega Select, Pigeon, Nirlon, Milton
skuLines.notes: Also the single-item purchase of university students setting up a room; keep the cheapest 20cm SKU always in stock.

skuLines.line: Milk pan / sauce pan, 1–1.5 L (steel and non-stick)
skuLines.examples: Milton sauce pan, Vinod SS milk pan, Pigeon non-stick
skuLines.notes: The classic hostel SKU (tea, milk, Maggi). Check hostel rules on in-room heating before pushing the appliance to match it.

skuLines.line: Patila / handi / degchi — stainless steel with lid, 1–6 L
skuLines.examples: Vinod SS handi set, Dynore handi 3-pc, Milton Pro Cook, local heavy-gauge bartan
skuLines.notes: Verified mass-end steel handi set with lid ₹593. Unbranded heavy-gauge steel is the margin engine of this whole category because it carries no printed MRP.

skuLines.line: Bhagona / stock pot / langar vessel, 10–40 L
skuLines.examples: Dynore heavy-gauge bhagona, Kitchen Pro stock pot, local Jagadhri bartan
skuLines.seasonality: Gurpurab, Baisakhi, langar seva, weddings and campus functions
skuLines.notes: Institutional/seva line. Better sold as a rental-plus-deposit service than as stock — one set turns many times a year and the capital sits in the store, not in a family's loft.

skuLines.line: Cooker separators / stackable inserts
skuLines.examples: Prestige separators, Hawkins separator set, universal 3-pc steel
skuLines.notes: Attaches to every cooker sale — cooking dal and rice together on one LPG cylinder matters where refills come up the hill.

skuLines.line: Steamer — idli stand, dhokla plate, momo/appam pan
skuLines.examples: Butterfly idli cooker, Prestige idli stand, NSVL appam patra, steel momo steamer
skuLines.notes: Momo steamer sells better than idli in a Himachal hill campus — stock to the local eating habit, not the national planogram.

skuLines.line: Milk boiler / double-bottom milk pot, 1–2 L
skuLines.examples: Milton milk boiler, Pigeon, Dynore double-bottom
skuLines.notes: Married-staff families with babies buy this the week the baby comes home; pair it on the shelf with baby feeding steel.

skuLines.line: Pressure pan / 2–3 L pan cooker
skuLines.examples: Prestige Popular pan 3L, Hawkins Contura pan 2L
skuLines.notes: Same BIS rule as cookers. Sells to small households (1-2 people) — young unmarried staff quarters.

skuLines.line: Tea pan / chai patila, 0.75–1.5 L
skuLines.examples: Dynore tea pan, local steel chai patila, Milton
skuLines.notes: High-frequency, low-ticket, burns out and gets replaced. Cold hill station = tea is made several times a day in every room.

skuLines.line: Chapati/roti box — insulated hot case, 1–1.5 L
skuLines.examples: Milton Marvel chapati box, Cello Chapati Server, Jaypee
skuLines.notes: In a cold location this is not a convenience item — rotis go cold in minutes. Deepen stock Oct-Feb.

skuLines.line: Insulated casserole / hot pot, 2.5–5 L and gift sets
skuLines.examples: Milton Oyster (₹528–550 verified), Milton Regent, Cello Chef, Jaypee casserole (₹616–3,550 verified)
skuLines.seasonality: Diwali/Dhanteras and wedding gifting (Oct-Feb); winter use
skuLines.notes: The default Indian gifting SKU — a 3-piece set at a ₹999/₹1,499 price point moves on its own in festive weeks. Bulky and light: it eats shelf and truck space, so pre-book festive quantity in one consignment.

skuLines.line: Vacuum flask / thermos, 500 ml–1 L
skuLines.examples: Milton Thermosteel Flip Lid, Cello Swift, Borosil Hydra, Jaypee vacuum flask
skuLines.notes: A cold hill township's signature category — hot tea carried to class, duty, night rounds. Elderly and night-duty staff are the deepest buyers. Verified Milton insulated bottle street prices ₹613–825.

skuLines.line: Airpot / large thermos carafe, 1.9–3.5 L
skuLines.examples: Milton Thermosteel Carafe, Jaypee vacuum kettle, Cello
skuLines.notes: Buys from staff rooms, hostel wardens, canteens and function organisers rather than households — sell on indent, keep one facing.

skuLines.line: Thermosteel water bottle, 750 ml–1 L
skuLines.examples: Milton Atlantis ₹613–725, Milton Aura ₹761–825, Cello Duro, Borosil Hydra Trek
skuLines.notes: Prices above are live-verified from Milton's own site. This has replaced the plastic bottle as the default student bottle nationally — carry 3 price points (₹599 / ₹899 / ₹1,299) and 4-5 colours; colour choice drives the sale.

skuLines.line: Single-wall steel school water bottle, 600–900 ml
skuLines.examples: Milton Steel Bottle, Cello Puro Steel, Jaypee school bottle
skuLines.seasonality: Sharp spike at session start (Apr) and reopening (Jul); steady loss-replacement all year
skuLines.notes: 5,000 residents including a residential school: bottles are lost and dented constantly, making this one of the fastest-repeating lines in the category. Stock deep, in school-approved plain colours, plus replacement caps/stoppers (₹110–195 verified).

skuLines.line: Kids' character sipper bottle, 400–600 ml
skuLines.examples: Milton Kool range, Cello Puro Kids, Jaypee school utility, licensed Disney/Marvel prints
skuLines.notes: For married-staff families with small children and the youngest school classes. Character licensing is the demand driver in 2026; also the easiest ₹200 gift on campus.

skuLines.line: PET/plastic fridge bottle set, 1 L (set of 4–6)
skuLines.examples: Cello H2O, Milton Pacific, Nayasa PET bottles
skuLines.notes: Food-grade / BPA-free claim should be on pack (IS 10146-type food-contact plastic). Sold as sets — never break a set, the per-piece price destroys the value story.

skuLines.line: Copper water bottle / copper jug, 900 ml–1.5 L
skuLines.examples: Milton Copper, Prestige Tattva, Indian Art Villa
skuLines.notes: Wellness-led line (Milton, Nayasa and Borosil all now list copper). Tarnishes on shelf — rotate and keep in the box until sold.

skuLines.line: Gym / hydration bottle and shaker, 1.2–2 L
skuLines.examples: Milton hydration bottle, Cello sipper, Nayasa Sprint Gym Shaker ₹319
skuLines.notes: Large-format bottles are the visible 2026 trend among 18-25s. Ties to the sports/gym crowd of Eternal University — merchandise near protein/energy lines if the store carries them.

skuLines.line: Steel tiffin / lunch box, 2–3 container
skuLines.examples: Milton steel tiffin, Jaypee tiffin, Dynore 3-container
skuLines.notes: Verified Borosil steel lunchbox sets ₹615–1,250 at the premium end. Non-teaching staff carry food to duty daily — this is a working line, not a gift line.

skuLines.line: Insulated leak-proof lunch box with bag, 3–4 containers
skuLines.examples: Milton Delite/Cube, Cello Max Fresh, Signoraware, Jaypee insulated (₹387+ verified)
skuLines.notes: Leak-proof gasket is the whole product — stock a brand whose lids actually seal, because a returned tiffin cannot be exchanged 40 km away.

skuLines.line: Kids' compartment lunch box (plastic body / steel insert)
skuLines.examples: Cello Kids, Milton Bon Bon, Signoraware school range, Borosil kids
skuLines.notes: Highest-velocity kids' line alongside bottles. School may mandate steel inserts over plastic — confirm with the academy before buying the season's quantity.

skuLines.line: Tiffin carrier — 3–4 tier clip carrier
skuLines.examples: Milton clip carrier, Dynore 4-tier, local steel carrier
skuLines.notes: Used to carry a full meal across the township — to a spouse on duty, to a patient, to seva. Unbranded steel carries the better margin.

skuLines.line: Steel thali / dinner plate, 10–13 inch (mess grade)
skuLines.examples: Dynore heavy-gauge thali, Jagadhri/local bartan, Milton
skuLines.notes: Continuous replacement demand from hostels and canteens (loss, denting). Stock two gauges: a cheap student plate and a heavy mess plate — and sell the heavy one to institutions by weight-equivalent logic.

skuLines.line: Steel katori / bowl set (6 pc)
skuLines.examples: Dynore katori set, local bartan, Milton steel bowls
skuLines.notes: Pairs with the thali line; institutional buyers take both together. Unbranded, no MRP, good margin.

skuLines.line: Steel glass / tumbler, 250–350 ml (set of 6)
skuLines.examples: Dynore tumbler set, Milton steel glass, local bartan
skuLines.notes: Steel over glass is the right call for a campus — no breakage, no injury risk with children around.

skuLines.line: Cutlery — steel spoons, forks, teaspoons (pack of 6–12)
skuLines.examples: Shapes, Sumeet, FnS, local steel cutlery
skuLines.notes: Teaspoons disappear faster than any other utensil in shared kitchens and messes. Keep a loose-piece bin as well as packs — the loose sale is the higher margin.

skuLines.line: Cooking tools — palta/turner, ladle, chimta (tongs), masher, skimmer
skuLines.examples: Dynore steel tools, Prestige, Pigeon, silicone/wooden tools for non-stick
skuLines.notes: Best margin band in the whole category and the cheapest to freight. Carry both steel (for iron/steel vessels) and silicone/wooden (for non-stick) — selling steel tools with a non-stick tawa is how coatings get ruined.

skuLines.line: Chakla-belan, roti press, puri press
skuLines.examples: Wooden chakla-belan set, marble chakla, steel roti press, Signoraware
skuLines.notes: Wooden chakla warps in monsoon humidity — store off the floor. Marble is heavy freight but does not warp; carry one of each.

skuLines.line: Sieve/chalni (atta), colander, rice washer
skuLines.examples: Dynore atta chalni, Nayasa colander, steel strainer
skuLines.notes: Cheap, light, high-margin, and there is nowhere else on the hill to buy one.

skuLines.line: Kitchen knife, peeler, scissors, chopping board
skuLines.examples: Pigeon knife set, Prestige, Ganesh peeler, Nayasa PP board, Victorinox (premium)
skuLines.notes: Keep sharp knives behind the counter with children in the store. A sharpening service (see adjacent services) turns this from one-off into a repeat footfall driver.

skuLines.line: Hand chopper, grater/slicer, squeezer and small gadgets
skuLines.examples: Pigeon Handy Chopper 900ml, Ganesh 6-in-1 grater, lemon squeezer, garlic press
skuLines.notes: Impulse-priced and demo-driven — a chopper sells when someone sees it work at the counter. Blades are the failure point; check spare availability before committing to a brand.

skuLines.line: Masala dabba (7-compartment spice box) and spice jars
skuLines.examples: Dynore steel masala box, Wonderchef spice box ₹1,399, Cello spice rack
skuLines.notes: First thing bought when a family moves into staff quarters — merchandise it with the storage-container wall, not with cookware.

skuLines.line: Steel airtight storage jars / dabba set (300 ml–2 L)
skuLines.examples: Milton Steel Jars, Jaypee jars & containers (₹372–1,232 verified), Nayasa steel jars
skuLines.notes: Heavy monsoon means airtight is a functional need, not a nicety — sugar, salt and masala cake up. Steel outsells plastic where families keep things for years.

skuLines.line: Plastic airtight kitchen container set, 1–5 L (atta/rice/dal)
skuLines.examples: Cello Modustack, Milton storage, Nayasa kitchen storage, Tupperware (premium)
skuLines.notes: Nayasa runs curated ₹499/₹999/₹1,499 tiers — mirror those price walls on the shelf. Stackable/modular is what sells in 2026; loose mismatched containers do not.

skuLines.line: Grain drum / large canister, 10–30 kg
skuLines.examples: Nayasa storage drum, Cello, Prince, steel grain drum
skuLines.notes: Rodents and damp are the real enemy in hill quarters — rat-proof steel or thick-wall plastic with a locking lid. Bulky: freight is the whole cost question, so buy in a full-truck consolidation.

skuLines.line: Microwave/oven-safe glass containers and borosilicate bowls
skuLines.examples: Borosil Klip-N-Store, Borosil glass lunch boxes (₹557–1,608 verified), Treo, Larah
skuLines.notes: Prices live-verified from myborosil.com. Glass = the highest transit-breakage risk on a hill route; order in original master cartons only and budget 3-5% damage.

skuLines.line: Jug — plastic/steel 1.5–2 L, and insulated jug 2–3 L
skuLines.examples: Milton insulated jug, Cello jug, Nayasa, Jaypee jugs & glasses
skuLines.seasonality: Summer for plain; winter and functions for insulated
skuLines.notes: Insulated jugs double as function/langar serving ware — a small rental pool covers campus events.

skuLines.line: Water storage container with tap, 10–20 L
skuLines.examples: Nayasa water dispenser, Cello, Prince, steel matka with tap
skuLines.notes: Sells on water-supply reliability, not on season — a campus outage empties this shelf in a day, so hold a small buffer.

skuLines.line: Oil dispenser / ghee container / oil can, 500 ml–1 L
skuLines.examples: Milton oil dispenser, Nayasa, steel oil can, Borosil glass dispenser
skuLines.notes: Natural cross-sell with the store's own edible-oil shelf (Milton lists oil dispensers as a category in its own right) — place it beside the oil, not in cookware.

skuLines.line: Baby feeding steel — bowl-spoon set, suction plate, sipper cup, food flask
skuLines.examples: Milton kids range, Luvlap, Chicco, Borosil baby containers
skuLines.notes: Married staff with babies have no alternative source on campus. Insist on food-grade/BPA-free marking; a warm-food flask matters in a cold location. Keep it adjacent to baby care, not buried in utensils.

skuLines.line: Dinner set — opalware/melamine 18–27 pc, plus cup & saucer set
skuLines.examples: Larah by Borosil, La Opala, Milton opalware, Cello melamine
skuLines.notes: The high-ticket festive/gifting anchor of the category. Opalware chips rather than shatters, which travels better than bone china. Buy the festive quantity once — dead stock here is expensive.

skuLines.line: Ceramic mug / tea cup set (6 pc)
skuLines.examples: Borosil mugs, Cello, Milton ceramic, Clay Craft
skuLines.notes: Cold-weather tea culture makes this a steady seller and the default ₹250-₹400 gift between colleagues and students. Individual printed mugs move faster than sets among students.

skuLines.line: Glass tumbler set and glass jug
skuLines.examples: Borosil, Yera, Ocean, Treo
skuLines.notes: Keep shallow — steel wins on a campus with children, and glass carries the transit-breakage cost. One or two facings for guest/drawing-room use.

skuLines.line: Gas lighter, oven mitts / pot holder, apron
skuLines.examples: Pigeon gas lighter, local electronic lighter, cotton mitts, printed apron
skuLines.notes: Highest-margin, lowest-freight line here and a true stock-out emergency — a dead lighter means no cooking. Never let it go out of stock; keep it at the counter.

skuLines.line: Dish drainer rack / plate stand / kitchen shelf organiser
skuLines.examples: Nayasa racks, Cello, Peng Essentials steel rack, local steel plate stand
skuLines.notes: Bulky and light — worst freight economics in the category. Buy flat-pack or knock-down versions where available, or source from the nearest plains market in bulk.

skuLines.line: Electric kettle, 1–1.5 L
skuLines.examples: Milton Go Electro ₹946–1,150, Pigeon kettle, Prestige, Butterfly
skuLines.notes: Borderline appliance, but it is the one every hostel room and staff quarter wants in a cold climate. Needs BIS registration, a warranty card and a service route — the store becomes the de-facto claim drop point. Verify hostel electrical rules before stocking deep.

skuLines.line: Electric lunch box / hot case (roti-food warmer)
skuLines.examples: Milton electric tiffin, Jaypee electric casserole ₹2,120, Cello electric
skuLines.notes: A visible 2026 growth SKU (Milton and Jaypee both now list electric tiffins/casseroles). One or two pieces as a winter feature, not a base line.

skuLines.line: Clay / earthen cookware — handi, tawa, kulhad
skuLines.examples: Village Decor clay handi, Indus Valley earthen pot, local Himachali potter, kulhads
skuLines.notes: Best sourced from a nearby potter rather than freighted — breakage on hill roads is brutal. Kulhads for canteen chai are the practical, repeating half of this line.

trends2026: Triply / stainless steel is displacing hard-anodised and cheap non-stick at the mid-premium end, sold on a "toxin-free, no coating to flake" health story — Vinod lists triply from ₹2,280 to ₹8,490 and Wonderchef prices triply ₹1,349-3,699 alongside ceramic-coated ₹1,799-2,699.

Cast iron and plain-iron cookware revival (iron-fortified cooking): Wonderchef Ferro Light ₹1,249-1,899, Rock Tawa, Indus Valley, plus a very cheap marketplace iron end at ₹363-450 that sets the price expectation.

Thermosteel as the default, not the premium: 750ml-1L insulated steel bottles have replaced plastic as the standard student/staff bottle (Milton Atlantis ₹613-725, Aura ₹761-825), with large-format 1.2-2L hydration bottles growing among 18-25s.

Q-commerce (Blinkit/Zepto/Instamart) now runs full kitchen-utility aisles at 10-minute delivery, which sets a visible national price benchmark even where delivery does not reach — a captive-market store has to look MRP-fair or residents price-check on their phones.
Modular, stackable, airtight storage in curated price walls: Nayasa merchandises at ₹499/₹999/₹1,499/₹1,999 tiers, and Cello/Milton/Jaypee push BPA-free stackable sets over loose containers.
Borosilicate and opal glass containers/lunchboxes going mainstream at ₹557-1,608 (Borosil), sold on microwave-safe and "no plastic touching hot food".
Electric tiffins, electric casseroles and mini appliances creeping into the lunchbox category (Milton and Jaypee both list electric lunchboxes/casseroles at ₹1,200-2,600).
Sustainability and back-to-material: clay/earthen handis, kulhads, bamboo and wooden utensils, copper bottles and jugs (Milton, Nayasa, Borosil and Prestige Tattva all now carry copper).
Kids' licensed-character bottles and lunchboxes as the school-season demand driver, with school-mandated steel inserts pushing out all-plastic boxes.

Market context: India kitchenware measured at USD 6.7 bn in 2025 heading to USD 11.5 bn by 2034 (~5.9% CAGR), with growth attributed to premiumisation, online retail and health/eco-led material switching (IMARC).
adjacentServices: Pressure-cooker service counter: gasket, safety valve, weight and handle replacement while-you-wait — the single most valuable service in a market 30-50 km from the nearest spares shop, and it pulls the household back into the store 2-3 times a year.
Knife, scissor and peeler sharpening (weekly sharpening day) — near-zero cost, converts a one-off knife sale into recurring footfall.
Non-stick re-coating / repair aggregation: collect tawas and kadhais, send a batch to the plains vendor monthly, return re-coated — sells against a full replacement.
Dhanteras/festive purana-bartan exchange scheme (old steel weighed off against new), the standard Indian utensil-retail footfall engine in Oct-Nov.

Institutional indent supply to the two canteens, hostel messes and the F&V counter — mess thalis, katoris, tumblers, bhagonas, 12-22L cookers on a written requirement with monthly settlement instead of shelf stock.

Rental pool with deposit for large langar/function vessels (bhagona, patila, insulated jugs, airpots, casseroles) for Gurpurab, Baisakhi, weddings and campus events — one set turns many times and keeps capital in the store.

"Starter kit" bundles at ₹999 / ₹1,499 / ₹2,499 for new students, new staff and newly allotted married quarters (cooker + tawa + patila + tiffin + bottle + tools), pre-packed and pushed at session start.
Gift-wrap and institutional gifting desk: casserole and dinner sets for teacher's day, retirements, weddings and seva donations, with bulk pricing for departments.

Warranty and service drop point for branded cookware and small appliances (Milton, Prestige, Pigeon, Hawkins) — the store logs the claim and ships the unit, since no resident can carry it down the hill.
Kitchen-name engraving / marking on steel plates, tumblers and bottles for hostels and messes — cuts loss, and is a paid add-on of ₹10-20 per piece.
WhatsApp order and in-campus home delivery for heavy or bulky items (grain drums, stock pots, dish racks) that residents cannot carry from the store.
Cooking-advice counter tied to product: which vessel suits LPG vs induction, how to season iron in monsoon, how to keep non-stick alive — reduces returns that cannot be sent back anyway.

NOTE ON METHOD: this session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before this task started, so no keyword searches could be run — the list was built from the direct page fetches above plus category knowledge. BigBasket, Blinkit, Zepto, JioMart, Amazon.in, Hawkins, Prestige, Cello, Signoraware and Tupperware all refused the fetch (403/404/503/DNS/JS-only), so their assortments are represented indirectly. Consequence: brand and price bands are indicative street/MRP ranges, verified only where a URL above is cited; every margin band is an India-retail industry norm (unbranded steel and small tools high, MRP-printed branded cookware and appliances thin), NOT a figure pulled from a source — treat margins as estimates to be confirmed against ARY's own purchase data.
